d: Massive blow for universities in the UK and the US, as international students ditch the countries to pursue higher education in continental Europe and Asia. New survey shows that both postgraduate and undergraduate courses in Britain and America are facing a shortfall of foreign students. Firstpost looks at the deficit of international students flocking to the US and the UK. Hem Kaur saroya explains how visa policies are forcing students to reconsider studying in the US and the UK.
